title: BYO corpus record — gmail
description: A Gmail message. Title maps to the Subject header; content to the body. Recipients (readers) determine who can read the mailbox item.

content.description: The thread's first message body, served verbatim. May be EMPTY, unlike every other source: a thread opened by a header-only message (an auto-forward, a calendar notice) still carries its content in `messages`.

title.description: Document title (email subject / file name / issue title / page title).

mailbox.description: The mailbox this document belongs to (default: the source_type).

group.description: ACL group owning the mailbox (default: slug(container)); null means the container owns no group, so nothing is group-scoped to it.

author_name.description: The SENDER's display name, used for their principal entry. The name served as the message's owner is `mailbox_owner` — a mailbox's owner is usually not the sender of a given message in it.

visibility.description: public = org-wide, group = the container's group, private = author only.

readers.description: Explicit reader principals. `user:<email>` / `group:<id>` / `org:<name>` state the type; unprefixed, an address is a user and anything else a group. Overrides visibility — and an EMPTY array means nobody may read the document (admin-only), not everybody.

meta.description: Free-form per-source structured extras merged into the record.

html.description:
HTML body for the text/html MIME part (default: content wrapped in

).

created.description: Sent/received time (epoch seconds or ISO 8601). Default: synthesized. Drives Date + internalDate.

mailbox_owner.description: Display name of the MAILBOX's owner, served as the message's owner. Distinct from `author_name`: the owner of a mailbox is often not the sender of a given message in it.

messages.description: The thread's later messages — this record is the first one. Each is a full RFC822 message with its own sender, recipients and Message-ID, sharing this record's thread id and ACL and taking the next `thread_seq`. Gmail's own child-row array: `replies` is Slack's (a reply, with reactions and files), and a thread of emails is not that.

content.description: Message body. May be empty — a header-only message (auto-ack, bare forward) is still a message in the thread.

created.description: Sent time (default: the root's + an hour per position).
